rubric.criterion: The real initial image shows Settings home and links to this attempt.
The framework decides and executes navigation; durable intent precedes each device action; before/after images are retained.
The final real image shows About and readable model/system version; the reported values match that image and are cross-checked against device metadata where available.

tasks.judgement: Assistant records per-milestone assessment and evidence references, then submits to user review. Agent completion text or HDC metadata alone cannot pass M2/M3. A manual navigation is separately labeled and cannot count as a candidate-loop success.

proposed_limits.context_policy: Task plus current image and only necessary recent history. Inspect actual SDK prompt and image payload locally; freeze a serialized-payload/image-count bound before the first request. A byte bound is not an input-token guarantee.
proposed_limits.hard_limit_note: Request count and output limits must be enforced at the actual model transport, including internal SDK requests/retries. Action limits must be enforced at device dispatch. SDK loop count alone is insufficient.

tasks.actual_initial_state: Split Settings home with NearLink/Bluetooth category selected; operator preparation separately recorded. About page not already selected at Agent start.

tasks.reason: Only after SYS trial, verify actual Harmony QQ Music installation/version, timer availability, permitted initial state and reset. Reuse the frozen task and milestones; do not invent a pass or silently change its 30-minute timer target.
